shadow-sorcery.summary: A Sorcerer whose magic springs from the Shadowfell, seeing through darkness, cheating death and calling shadow hounds.

Shadow Spells.summary: Always prepared: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds and Pass Without Trace at Sorcerer 3; Hunger of Hadar and Nondetection at 5; Greater Invisibility and Phantasmal Killer at 7; Contagion and Creation at 9.

Power of Shadow.summary: Darkvision 120 ft and Blindsight 10 ft, and you see through Darkness your own spells make. Once per Long Rest, when you would drop to 0 HP without dying, a CHA save (DC 5 + damage) leaves you at CHA + Sorcerer level HP.

options.name: Eyes of the Dark
options.summary: Darkvision 120 ft, Blindsight 10 ft; your spells’ Darkness doesn’t block your sight.

options.name: Strength of the Grave
options.summary: On dropping to 0 HP (not killed), CHA save DC 5 + damage taken; success sets your HP to CHA + Sorcerer level. Once per Long Rest after a success.

Beasts of Ill Omen.summary: Spend 3 Sorcery Points: cast Summon Beast as a Bonus Action with no slot, preparation or Material components; it looks like shadow, and enemies within 5 ft of it have Disadvantage on saves against your spells. You may drop Concentration, making it last 1 minute and end if you recast.

Shadow Walk.summary: Bonus Action in Dim Light or Darkness: teleport up to 120 ft to a space you see that is also dim or dark.

Umbral Form.summary: When you use Innate Sorcery, become shadow while it lasts: move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end a turn inside) and resist all damage but Force and Radiant. Once per Long Rest, or spend 6 Sorcery Points.

options.name: Incorporeal Movement
options.summary: Pass through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; ending your turn inside one deals 1d10 Force to you.

options.name: Shadow Resilience
options.summary: Resistance to every damage type except Force and Radiant.
